facts.text: High school applicants with an ACT composite score of 25 (with no subscores below 20) and an unweighted 3.3 GPA in a college-preparatory curriculum receive automatic admission to the Louisiana Scholars' College without submitting the supplemental packet.

sources.title: Louisiana Scholars' College | Northwestern State University
sources.quote: students who have an ACT composite score of 25 (no subscores below 20) and an unweighted GPA of 3.3 (out of 4.0 in Regents' or comparable curriculum) are entitled to automatic admission.
